**q25:**
CEL (Common Expression Language) engine at `internal/filter/engine.go`; the `Engine.Compile` method parses the filter string into a CEL AST, `buildCondition` in `internal/filter/parser.go` walks it into a dialect-agnostic condition tree, and `Render` in `internal/filter/render.go` emits dialect-specific SQL WHERE fragments by switching on dialect name (sqlite/mysql/postgres), appended via `AppendConditions` in `internal/filter/helpers.go`.

**q26:** `memo`, `memo_relation`, `attachment`
(The API handler also recursively deletes comment memos via `memo_relation` type COMMENT, so the same three tables are hit for each child comment as well.)

**q27:**
`go:embed` + Echo `StaticWithConfig` middleware; `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`
(line 20: `//go:embed dist/*` into `embed.FS`, line 41+: `Serve` method wires `StaticWithConfig` with SPA fallback)

**q28:**
S3 presign runner — `time.Ticker` every 12 hours (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`, started in `server/server.go:153-170`)
Webhook async dispatch workers (×4) — channel-driven (`internal/webhook/webhook.go`, `init()` launches 4 goroutines consuming from `asyncPostQueue`)

Unused infrastructure:
- `internal/scheduler` — full cron-expression scheduler with middleware; not imported by any production code
- `server/runner/memopayload` — `Runner` struct exists but is never started as a background runner; only its `RebuildMemoPayload` function is called synchronously inline

**q29:**
interceptor path: `web/src/connect.ts` (authInterceptor, line 156)
token kinds: JWT access tokens (short-lived, 15 min), JWT refresh tokens (30-day, HTTP-only cookie `memos_refresh`), Personal Access Tokens (PAT, `memos_pat_` prefix)
backend package: `server/auth` (`authenticator.go`, `token.go`); backend interceptor at `server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go`

**q30:**
`memos.memo.created`: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:15`)
`memos.memo.updated`: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:20`)
`memos.memo.deleted`: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:25`)
`memos.memo.comment.created`: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:30`)

All converge on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (line 48) → `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`
